messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: vpc-toolcall failures detected for tenant 'aurelia-health' in prod-vpc-7. Error spikes beginning ~23:14 UTC. Paging eng-oncall + eng-sre.
maria: ack. i'm on it — pulling recent deploys and error rates.
raj: paging in, grabbing logs from prod-vpc-7. can someone check whether this correlates with the rollback/patch from last night?
incident-bot: Auto-page sent to @eng-oncall @eng-sre. Incident ID: INC-2026-4021
eli: i'm seeing repeated parser failures in toolcall handler: parser_v2 throwing a JSON path resolution error. sample log:
```
2026-03-15T23:14:08Z ERROR parser_v2: path_resolve_failed tenant=aurelia-health request_id=ab12cd34 err="unexpected token at 'context.trace_id'"
payload={"tool_call":{"name":"getPatient","args":{"patient_id":"1234"},"meta":{"trace_id":"0001-abc"}}}
```
eli: note: payload.meta.trace_id exists, but our parser_v2 expects trace_id at top-level `meta.trace_id` OR older callers put trace_id in `context.trace_id` — mismatch looks like a schema drift for this tenant's toolcall client.
sasha: did anything land to prod that changed the parser semantics? i remember we tightened JSON path checks in parser_v2 last week.
raj: we rolled model runtime v2.3.4 + parser_v2 config change at 2026-03-14T02:10 UTC to enforce strict path resolution. that matches the timeline.
helen: customer SE here — Aurelia reported ~18% of their toolcall requests returning 500s starting this morning. They are on a Dedicated pool. They're asking if there's a quick fix.
maria: impact summary: Dedicated pool 'prod-vpc-7' -> tenant aurelia-health. ~18% 500s, latency unaffected for other tenants. No billing/quotas triggered yet. SLA alert on our side.
raj: mitigation proposal 1: route aurelia-health to stable model variant v2.2.9 (pre-parser change) on their dedicated pool. proposal 2: enable parser backward_compat flag (quick config flip). proposal 3: inject a transient mapping shim in the request proxy to remap `context.trace_id` -> `meta.trace_id` for this tenant.
eli: i can implement shim in the proxy quickly for just this tenant. config snippet i tested locally:
```
# tenant-specific request-proxy transform
if tenant_id == "aurelia-health":
  if payload.get("context") and payload["context"].get("trace_id"):
    payload.setdefault("meta", {})["trace_id"] = payload["context"]["trace_id"]
```
ops-runner: running tenant routing command: `infractl route set --tenant aurelia-health --model v2.2.9 --pool prod-vpc-7 --force` — started (job id job-7781). Will stream status.
incident-bot: Update: infra job job-7781 started at 23:20:11 UTC.
raj: can we hold a canary after routing? only route 10% first to watch error rate.
maria: yes, 10% canary. eli, please apply proxy shim to canary path first.
eli: applying shim to canary now... patch:
```
PATCH /proxy/tenants/aurelia-health/transform
body={"transforms":[{"when":"tool_call","apply":"map_context_trace_to_meta"}], "traffic_split": 0.1}
```
eli: canary applied. monitoring logs.
raj: initial results: canary error rate down from 18% -> 3.4% for that slice.
helen: i've told the customer: "We're routing a small percentage to a stable model and applying a temporary shim; we'll escalate to a full routing if canary looks good."
maria: good. ops-runner, what's status of the full route job?
ops-runner: job-7781 status: rolling -> 25% -> 50% now. ETA to 100% ~ 6 minutes.
eli: full routing complete at 23:27:44 UTC. verifying.
raj: post-routing metrics: error rate for aurelia-health is now 0.9% over the last 2 minutes (was 18%). Latency normal.
maria: mitigation successful. immediate customer impact mitigated by routing + shim. next: we need a durable fix and postmortem.
sasha: ownership: i'll take on long-term parser reconciliation and upgrade path. eli/raj to investigate why the schema drift wasn't caught by our regression evals. maria to coordinate customer communication and SLA remediation.
eli: quick note: logs show two different client SDK versions at play from Aurelia — some callers send `context.trace_id`, others `meta.trace_id`. Our strict parser change failed the mixed-case. I'll add a tolerant parsing path with a unit test matrix for mixed payloads.
raj: action item: add a canary gating check in CI that runs sample toolcall payloads from enterprise tenants against parser changes.
maria: i've notified Aurelia via email and set expectation for full rollback docs + postmortem. SE Helen will coordinate compensation if SLA breach thresholds are hit.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4021 mitigation in place. Updating incident channel and creating postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/incidents/INC-2026-4021
sasha: handing off to eng-sre for RCA and long-term remediation. assigning to @eli and @sasha. please update this thread with timeline for fixes.
eli: noted. I'll open a follow-up bug with test cases and a PR to add the tolerant parser plus canary gating. ETA PR tomorrow EOD.
maria: thanks team. i'll close the page once SRE confirms monitoring stable for 2 hours. leaving this thread open for handoff notes.
helen: customer updated and appreciative of quick action. they asked for a short summary to share with their security/compliance team; i will draft and post here.
maria: drafting summary now. cc: @helen for customer-facing text.
sasha: postmortem meeting scheduled: 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC. calendar invite sent.
ops-runner: monitoring alert baseline restored. All clear pending RCA.
